name: The Turncoat's Mirror
text: A tall mirror stands in a ruined chapel. In it, you have the same scars but a different class.

choices.label: Step through (new class, class levels reset)
choices.resultText: You come out the other side trained in a different class.

choices.label: Turn away
choices.resultText: Your reflection turns away a moment after you do.

name: Goldbough Avatar
text: A huge figure kneels in a clearing, its legs grown into the roots of a golden sapling. It holds out one open hand.

choices.label: Offer a card (lose a random card, take 6 damage)
choices.resultText: The card turns to gold leaf, and its grip on your hand draws blood.

choices.label: Pray (heal 20% max HP, gain a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: Your wounds close, but guilt follows you out of the clearing.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: Its hand stays open as you go.

name: Abandoned Merchant Cart
text: A trader's cart lies tipped in the mud beside a split strongbox. Fresh bootprints lead away from it.

choices.label: Loot the strongbox (gain 75 cinders, the owners may return)
choices.resultText: As you pocket the cinders, someone behind you clears their throat.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You leave the cart where it lies.

name: Wayward Pilgrim
text: A soaked pilgrim holds out a cloth bundle. "Fifty cinders, and my sister's keepsake is yours."

choices.label: Pay 50 cinders (gain a random relic)
choices.resultText: She hands you the bundle and walks off into the rain.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.resultText: She nods as if she expected that.

name: Bloodstained Altar
text: A dark stone altar has channels cut for blood. It sharpens what you give it and keeps a share.

choices.label: Offer your blood (upgrade 2 random cards, lose 8% max HP)
choices.resultText: The channels fill, and two of your cards come back sharper.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The altar waits for someone else.

name: Wandering Physician
text: A physician in a rotting coat lays out his knives. "I can cut something out of you, or just patch you up."

choices.label: Let him cut (remove a random card, take 4 damage)
choices.resultText: He holds something up to the light and pockets it before you can look.

choices.label: Let him patch you (heal 15% max HP)
choices.resultText: He stitches you up quickly and refuses payment.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: "Suit yourself. The spire will finish the job."

name: Golden Moth
text: A moth as big as a shield lies dying on a broken pillar. Cinders drip from its wings.

choices.label: Gather the cinders (gain 40 cinders)
choices.resultText: The cinders come away easily, and the moth does not stop you.

choices.label: Sit with it (heal 10% max HP)
choices.resultText: You stay until it dies and rise feeling lighter.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You leave it to die alone.

name: Shrine of the Feral Ember
text: A crude shrine of antlers and wax. Embers pool at its base, and fresh claw marks circle it.

choices.label: Take the offering (random relic, its guardian attacks)
choices.resultText: You grab the relic, and its guardian comes out of the brush behind you.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You leave the embers alone.

name: Ancient Cinder Stone
text: A standing stone hums with old writing. Reading it hurts, and smashing it would free its cinders.

choices.label: Study it (upgrade a random card, lose 7% max HP)
choices.resultText: The writing burns into your memory and leaves a headache behind.

choices.label: Smash it (gain 35 cinders)
choices.resultText: The stone breaks apart into cinders.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You leave the stone humming.

name: Grave of the Nameless
text:
A cairn of broken swords marks an untended grave.

Cinder-light seeps up between the blades, and the mound is quiet for now.

choices.label: Dig for cinders (gain 90 cinders, the grave may wake)
choices.resultText: The cinders come up cold, and the earth under the swords shifts.

choices.label: Pay respects (heal 15% max HP)
choices.resultText: You set a fallen blade upright and leave feeling lighter.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You leave the swords where they lie.

name: Sleeping Smith
text: A smith sleeps slumped over his anvil. His forge is cold, but the blade on it still hums.

choices.label: Take the blade (upgrade a random card)
choices.resultText: The hum stops the moment you lift it.

choices.label: Leave him a coin (pay 40 cinders, rank up a random card)
choices.resultText: His hammer falls once in his sleep, and one card comes back a rank higher.

choices.label: Wake him (pay 30 cinders, heal 12% max HP)
choices.resultText: He wakes long enough to patch you up, then dozes off again.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You let him sleep.

name: Wyrm Trial
text: A cracked stone ring marks an old trial ground. A lone soldier stands inside it, waiting for a challenger.

choices.label: Enter the ring (fight the soldier, gain 60 cinders)
choices.resultText: You cross the line, and the soldier moves to meet you.

choices.label: Go around it (lose 5% max HP, gain 20 cinders)
choices.resultText: The rubble cuts you up, but you find some cinders on the way.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You leave the ring alone.

name: Discarded Reliquary
text: A torn pack lies open by the trail, its owner gone. One card sits face down among the spoiled food.

choices.label: Take it all (gain 45 cinders and a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: You pocket the card before you can think better of it.

choices.label: Burn the pack (gain 25 cinders)
choices.resultText: The card curls to ash before you can read it.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You step around the pack and keep going.

name: Warden's Altar
text: An altar carved with a many-eyed face offers you its strength. In return, it watches through your eyes.

choices.label: Accept its gaze (gain a random relic and a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: You feel it settle in behind your eyes.

choices.label: Smash the altar (gain 70 cinders, fight its guardian)
choices.resultText: The face cracks in half, and its guardian answers the noise.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The carved eyes follow you down the road.

name: Blight-Priest's Offer
text: A priest with robes grown into his sores holds out a reliquary. "The Blight gives, and it only asks for flesh."

choices.label: Accept the blessing (gain a random relic, lose 10% max HP)
choices.resultText: The reliquary is warm, and the warmth spreads up your arm.

choices.label: Rob him (gain 50 cinders and a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: He does not resist, and he smiles as you take it.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: "The Blight is patient," he calls after you.

name: Handspider Nest
text: A nest of crawling hands guards a strongbox in the dark ahead. They have not noticed you yet.

choices.label: Grab the strongbox (gain 80 cinders, they may wake)
choices.resultText: The box scrapes free, and every finger in the nest goes still.

choices.label: Back away slowly
choices.resultText: You back out one step at a time, and the nest never stirs.

name: Seat of Faded Emberlight
text: A guiding ember burns low here. It has enough left to heal you or temper a blade, but not both.

choices.label: Warm yourself (heal 18% max HP)
choices.resultText: The last of the light soaks into you and goes out.

choices.label: Temper a blade (upgrade a random card, lose 6% max HP)
choices.resultText: You hold a card in the flame until it takes an edge, and it burns you too.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You leave the ember to burn out.

name: Merchant's Ghost
text: A ghost keeps a stall that is no longer there, and calls out, "I have something you'll want."

choices.label: Buy it (pay 60 cinders, gain a random relic)
choices.resultText: Your cinders vanish, and the relic it hands you is ice cold.

choices.label: Take it and run (gain a random relic and a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: It does not chase you, but it writes your name in its ledger.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: "Come again," it says to no one.

name: Cinderbear Den
text: Cinders glitter among the bones at the back of the cave. A cinderbear sleeps by the wall.

choices.label: Go for the hoard (gain 100 cinders, the bear likely wakes)
choices.resultText: Your hands fill with cinders, and behind you the breathing stops.

choices.label: Skim the edges (lose 5% max HP, gain 25 cinders)
choices.resultText: You scrape your ribs on the rock but get out with a few cinders.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You leave the bear to its sleep.

name: Stake of the Martyr
text: A gilded thorn stake juts from the path. It offers a relic for one of your cards and some of your blood.

choices.label: Pay its price (remove a random card, lose 8% max HP, gain a random relic)
choices.resultText: The stake drinks, and leaves an old relic in your hand.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The stake hums behind you as you go.

name: The Oracle's Riddle
text: Two giant fingers rise from a pool, tapping a slow rhythm. Read one way it sharpens the mind, and read another it heals.

choices.label: Sharpen (upgrade 2 random cards, take 5 damage)
choices.resultText: The rhythm lodges in your head, and two cards come back sharper.

choices.label: Mend (heal 22% max HP, gain a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: Your wounds close, but the water keeps watching you.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The fingers keep tapping as you walk away.

name: The Keeper of the Nameless
text:
A figure in grave-clothes waits at a fork in the road with a lantern.

It knows what you did at the cairn of broken swords.

choices.label: Return what you took (pay 90 cinders, the keeper stands down)
choices.resultText: You drop the cinders into its lantern, and the keeper walks away.

choices.label: Stand your ground (fight, keep the cinders)
choices.resultText: The keeper walks off, and the figures behind it draw their weapons.

choices.label: Accept the keeper's thanks (gain the Gravetender's Bell)
choices.resultText: "One toll for each name," it says, and puts an iron bell in your hand.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The keeper does not follow you.

name: The Second Cairn
text:
A second cairn stands by the road, its swords fallen in the mud.

The keeper is gone, and no names are carved here.

choices.label: Raise the swords and keep vigil (upgrade 2 random cards)
choices.resultText: You stand watch until dawn, and the bell in your pack rings once.

choices.label: Raise the swords and rest (heal 30% max HP)
choices.resultText: You sleep among the stones, and nobody wakes you.

choices.label: Loot the barrow (gain 120 cinders and a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: You dig out the cinders and leave the swords in the mud.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You leave the swords where they fell.

name: The Last Lantern
text:
The Road Warden holds a broken lantern in the rain.

"Lantern Haven's medicine caravan needs this light, so buy oil or help me haul the beacon."

choices.label: Buy signal oil (pay 40 cinders, aid the caravan)
choices.resultText: The wick catches, and the Road Warden writes your name in the supply ledger.

choices.label: Haul the beacon (take 8 damage, aid the caravan)
choices.resultText: The iron frame cuts your hands, but its light clears the ridge.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The caravan will have to find another way.

name: The Caravan Comes Through
text:
Lantern Haven's wagons roll past under the light you helped raise.

"We owe you," says the Road Warden, "but that strongbox is medicine money."

choices.label: Learn from the quartermaster (upgrade a random card)
choices.resultText: The quartermaster shows you a cleaner way to move.

choices.label: Take wages for the climb (gain 60 cinders)
choices.resultText: The Road Warden counts out fair pay.

choices.label: Steal the strongbox (gain 100 cinders and a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: No one stops you, and the hamlets go without their medicine.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You wave the wagons on and ask for nothing.
